price_definition: abs((close-open)/causal_intraday_ATR) where ATR is the median true range of the prior 10-20 completed bars within the same session
expected_volume: median volume of the prior 20 completed sessions at the same Eastern-time five-minute slot
entry: signal on completed bar close; fill at next bar open
exit: close of the sixth bar beginning with the entry bar, truncated at session end
nominal_cost: one adverse tick per side plus stored commission per side
validation: chronological 70% IS / 30% OOS by session date
